name: Cobram Estate Olives Limited
summary: Cobram Estate Olives Limited produces and markets olive oil in Australia, the United States, and internationally. Its olive farming assets include various olive trees of freehold farmland in Victoria; and long-term leased and freehold properties in California. The company is also involved in olive farming; and owns olive tree nursery, olive mills, olive oil bottling and storage facilities, and olives laboratory. It sells its products under the Cobram Estate, Red Island, Modern Olives, California Olive Ranch, Lucini, and Oliv.iQ brand names. The company was formerly known as Boundary Bend Limited. Cobram Estate Olives Limited was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Lara, Australia.
